datasheet: TI CSD25310Q2 SLPS459C (Feb 2025, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/csd25310q2.pdf; local scratchpad/dl/esc03/csd25310q2.pdf): pinout p1 'Top View' (S = 1, 2, 5, 6 + large pad, G = 3, D = 4 + strip; D23), package DQK (S-PWSON-N6) p12-13 (4210192/B: body 1.90-2.10, 6X lead 0.25-0.35 wide, 0.20-0.30 long, pitch 0.65), exposed pads p14 (4210857/A: large 0.95 x 1.00, strip 0.30 x 0.75). SLPS459C has NO land pattern, so the lands come from TI CSD13202Q2 SLPS313A (Jan 2018, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/csd13202q2.pdf; local scratchpad/study-1-2s/dl/ds/csd13202q2.pdf) 7.1.1 Recommended PCB Pattern p9 and 7.1.2 stencil p10, the same TI DQK (Q2) package
derivation: Pad numbers 7 (strip) / 8 (large pad) as SLPS313A and the KiCad stock CSD25302Q2 symbol; the SLPS459C exposed-pad drawing (0.95 x 1.00 large pad offset to pins 1/6, 0.30 x 0.75 strip at the pin-4 column) matches the SLPS313A pads 8/7 within its +-0.10 tolerance. Paste: TI stencil pad 8 0.90 x 0.86 (82 % of the land), pad 7 0.70 x 0.29, pins 1:1.
